Method of Attack: Polymorphic malware loader capable of ransomware and espionage attacks
Installs cryptocurrency miners on compromised machines
Uses domain generation algorithm (DGA) for command and control communication
Copies itself to local directories and creates loading point files
Downloads and executes encrypted binary injected into %Windows%\SysWow64\dllhost.exe
Checks for virtual environment and debugging to evade detection
Discoverer: Symantec, a division of Broadcom Software
Indicators of Compromise: Use of 'verble' suffix in domain names generated by DGA
Low detection rate on VirusTotal samples
